    total_dur = 0
    for s in songs:

        if d is not None:

    playlist_durations.append({'playlist_id': pid, 'title': pl.get('title', p.get('title')),

# Sort by total duration desc
playlist_durations.sort(key=lambda x: x['total_duration_secs'], reverse=True)

print('suitable_count', len(suitable))
if suitable:
    chosen = suitable[0]
else:
    # Fall back to the longest playlist
    chosen = playlist_durations[0] if playlist_durations else None
